text:
Aisha: Heads-up — SignalBridge legal asked if we can demonstrate parity vs their current vendor for the POC. They care about prompt/response heuristics and billing deltas. Can we coordinate a short smoke plan?
Ben: I can own the tech checklist. Want to capture: input mapping, tokenization diffs, streaming behavior, role/system prompt handling.
Dana: +1. I'll prep a small prompt suite (10 canonical prompts + edgecases) and a normalization layer outline. Will add examples where the competitor injects system tokens.
Carlos: For POC infra we need to confirm static egress IPs (SignalBridge legal) and region placement. I can reserve a staging pool in us-east-1. Any storage/KMS requirements?
Eve: Security flags: SSO + SAML, SOC2 artifacts, and the security questionnaire item about model data residency. Also ask whether they need customer-managed KMS or our KMS.
Frank: Pricing question from procurement: do we show per-token comparison or projected monthly committed cost? They asked for a 12mo commit estimate with burst allowance.
Aisha: Procurement will want both. Can we show a side-by-side: 1) per-token expected cost at observed qps, 2) committed monthly with burst, and 3) fallback-cost when using a lower-cost quantized variant.
Ben: I'll produce a small benchmark with the same prompts and seq lengths to estimate token usage and latency. Will include a script so SignalBridge can re-run locally (curl + sample prompts). Example:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \ 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-small-v1","input":"<PROMPT>"}'
```
Dana: For response parity, plan: 1) normalize whitespace/token boundaries, 2) strip vendor-specific metadata, 3) canonicalize timestamps/IDs in outputs. We'll flag any semantic deltas for manual review.
Aisha: SignalBridge worried about hallucination deltas — they said one customer workflow fails with a rare grounding case. Any suggestions?
Ben: We'll add targeted evals for that workflow and compare probability mass on grounding tokens. If needed, we can tune decoding/stopping criteria and add a prefix KVCaching to preserve context.
Eve: Also remind SignalBridge to complete the security questionnaire — I answered most but need a point of contact for cloud architecture details. CC: @Carlos.
Carlos: noted. I'll share network diagram + subnet ranges. Also: if they require VPC peering for Private deployment, timeline is ~2 weeks for infra setup.
Frank: For commercial, we can offer a 3-month pilot with usage credits and an optional conversion credit toward a 12mo commit. That usually helps procurement bridge the risk.
Aisha: Great — can we have an internal checklist by EOD Friday? Items: prompt suite, benchmark script, security packet, pricing sheet, demo runbook.
Ben: I'll upload the benchmark artifacts to the POC repo and tag SignalBridge.
Dana: I'll drop the prompt suite + normalization rules into the repo (see TODOs).
Carlos: I'll add the IPs and network diagram to the repo and ping infra for VPC lead time.
Eve: I'll finish the questionnaire responses and export SOC2 excerpts.
deploy-bot: CI: smoke-run on signalbridge/poc passed (build 2026-03-21T15:03:02Z) :white_check_mark:
Aisha: Nice — small win. Let's target a kickoff call with SignalBridge next Tue 10am PT. Can everyone make it?
Ben: Yes.
Dana: Yes, will have the prompt suite ready enough for demo.
Carlos: Yes, will have network plan.
Eve: Yes.
Frank: Yes.
Aisha: Thanks team — I'll send calendar invite + pre-read (pricing + short risk doc).
